messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The best time to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, or price—but most travelers agree that **late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October)** offer the ideal mix of warm, pleasant weather, lower crowds, and better rates.

| Season | Why it’s great |
|--------|----------------|
| **Late Spring (April–May)** | Warm temperatures (mid‑70s °F / 24–26 °C), lower rainfall, and fewer tourists than the peak summer season. |
| **Early Fall (September–October)** | Still hot and sunny, but the summer crowds have thinned out, and you’ll often find good deals on accommodations. |

If you’re a big‑budget traveler who wants the absolute best weather and don’t mind higher prices, **June–August** is still fine—temperatures stay high (mid‑80s °F / 29–30 °C) and the islands are lush after the rainy season. However, this is also the busiest and most expensive period.

So, for a balance of comfort, affordability, and fewer crowds, aim for **April, May, September, or October**.
